summary: C3is Inc., a Greek-incorporated Nasdaq-listed shipping issuer, filed a Form 6-K attaching a November 5, 2026 press release announcing a one-for-five reverse stock split effective 11:59 pm ET November 8, 2026, with split-adjusted trading beginning November 9, 2026 under new CUSIP Y18284508. Outstanding shares fall from roughly 4.2 million to 0.84 million; par value is unchanged. Warrants and Series A Convertible Preferred adjust proportionately, with Class B and Class C warrants subject to an additional adjustment period ending the fifth trading day post-effectiveness. No fractional shares; cash in lieu. The board states the purpose is regaining Nasdaq's minimum bid price compliance. Watch for post-split trading support and any delisting notice.
